text:
version: 0.2
env:
  shell: bash
  exported-variables:
    - PAI_SOURCE_TREE_SHA256
    - PAI_DOCKERFILE_SHA256
    - PAI_OUTPUT_TAG
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - |
          set -euo pipefail
          PAI_BUILD_ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pai-source-XXXXXXXX)
          trap 'rm -rf "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT"' EXIT
          mkdir "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/tree"
          if [ "$PAI_SOURCE_TYPE" = S3 ]; then
            aws s3api get-object --bucket "$PAI_SOURCE_BUCKET" --key "$PAI_SOURCE_KEY" --version-id "$PAI_SOURCE_VERSION" "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/source.zip" >/dev/null
            export PAI_SOURCE_TREE_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/source.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)
            test "$PAI_SOURCE_TREE_SHA256" = "$PAI_SOURCE_SHA256"
            python3 - "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/source.zip" "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/tree" <<'PYSOURCE'
          import pathlib,stat,sys,zipfile
          root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]); total=0
          with zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]) as archive:
              entries=archive.infolist()
              if len(entries)>4096 or sum(entry.file_size for entry in entries)>128*1024*1024:
                  raise SystemExit('Source snapshot exceeds extraction limits')
              for entry in entries:
                  relative=pathlib.PurePosixPath(entry.filename)
                  mode=entry.external_attr>>16
                  if relative.is_absolute() or '..' in relative.parts or '\\' in entry.filename or stat.S_ISLNK(mode):
                      raise SystemExit('Unsafe source snapshot path')
                  target=root.joinpath(*relative.parts)
                  if entry.is_dir(): target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); continue
                  target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                  with archive.open(entry) as source,target.open('wb') as output:
                      while chunk:=source.read(1024*1024):
                          total+=len(chunk)
                          if total>128*1024*1024: raise SystemExit('Source snapshot exceeds extraction limits')
                          output.write(chunk)
                  target.chmod(0o755 if mode&0o111 else 0o644)
          PYSOURCE
          else
            cd "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR"
            test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PAI_SOURCE_COMMIT"
            test "$CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION" = "$PAI_SOURCE_COMMIT"
            git archive --format=tar "$PAI_SOURCE_COMMIT" -o "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/source.tar"
            export PAI_SOURCE_TREE_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/source.tar" | cut -d' ' -f1)
            tar -xf "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/source.tar" -C "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/tree"
          fi
          PAI_CONTEXT_PATH=$(realpath -e "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/tree/$PAI_BUILD_CONTEXT")
          PAI_DOCKERFILE_PATH=$(realpath -e "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/tree/$PAI_DOCKERFILE")
          case "$PAI_CONTEXT_PATH/" in "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/tree/"*) ;; *) exit 41;; esac
          case "$PAI_DOCKERFILE_PATH" in "$PAI_BUILD_ROOT/tree/"*) ;; *) exit 42;; esac
          test -d "$PAI_CONTEXT_PATH"
          test -f "$PAI_DOCKERFILE_PATH"
          export PAI_DOCKERFILE_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$PAI_DOCKERFILE_PATH" | cut -d' ' -f1)
          if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            dockerd --host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock >/tmp/pai-source-dockerd.log 2>&1 &
            for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
            docker info >/dev/null
          fi
          export PAI_OUTPUT_TAG="pai-source-${CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID##*:}"
          aws ecr get-login-password --region "$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "${PAI_OUTPUT_REPOSITORY_URI%%/*}"
          docker build --platform linux/amd64 --label "org.opencontainers.image.revision=$PAI_SOURCE_VERSION" --label "org.opencontainers.image.source=$PAI_SOURCE_REPOSITORY" -f "$PAI_DOCKERFILE_PATH" -t "$PAI_OUTPUT_REPOSITORY_URI:$PAI_OUTPUT_TAG" "$PAI_CONTEXT_PATH"
          docker push "$PAI_OUTPUT_REPOSITORY_URI:$PAI_OUTPUT_TAG"
